system.description:
First taught in Aldori, where the spellblade tradition was born, and now to the wardens of the O.M.G.A. in Opal: Abjuration carried on the edge of a blade, so the people beside you keep standing.

  • Warding Strike: when your Spellstrike hits, as well as Arcane Cascade, choose one ally within 10ft of you: the first attack against that ally before your next turn has Disadvantage.
    • 9th level: Warding Strike covers every ally within 10ft of you.
  • Ward-Reader: Advantage on checks to notice, study and identify wards, glyphs and other protective magic.
